GOOGLESHEETS_SEARCH_DEVELOPER_METADATA.description: Tool to search for developer metadata in a spreadsheet. Use when you need to find specific metadata entries based on filters.

a1Range.description: Selects DeveloperMetadata associated with the given A1 range. Must represent a single row or single column only. Valid examples: 'A:A' (entire column A), 'Sheet1!B:B' (column B in Sheet1), '1:1' (entire row 1), 'Sheet1!5:5' (row 5 in Sheet1). Invalid examples: 'A1:D7' (multi-row/multi-column range), 'A1' (single cell).

gridRange.description: Selects DeveloperMetadata associated with the given grid range. The developer metadata must be associated with a location that overlaps the range.

metadataId.description: Filters by the specific metadata ID.

visibility.description: Restricts to metadata with the specified visibility. Valid values: DEVELOPER_METADATA_VISIBILITY_UNSPECIFIED, DOCUMENT, PROJECT

locationType.description: Restricts the search to developer metadata of the specified location type. Valid values: DEVELOPER_METADATA_LOCATION_TYPE_UNSPECIFIED, ROW, COLUMN, SHEET, SPREADSHEET

sheetId.description: The ID of the sheet the metadata is associated with (sheet-wide association).

spreadsheet.description: True if the metadata is associated with the entire spreadsheet.

locationType.description: The type of location the metadata is associated with.

sheetId.description: The ID of the sheet this dimension range is on.

endIndex.description: The exclusive end index of the dimension range.

startIndex.description: The inclusive start index of the dimension range.

dimensionRange.description:
A range of a single dimension (either rows or columns) on a sheet.
Indexes are zero-based; endIndex is exclusive.

metadataLocation.description:
Describes the location where developer metadata is attached.
Exactly one of spreadsheet, sheetId, or dimensionRange is set,
and locationType reflects that location.

locationMatchingStrategy.description: Determines how the metadata location is matched. Valid values: DEVELOPER_METADATA_LOCATION_MATCHING_STRATEGY_UNSPECIFIED, EXACT_LOCATION, INTERSECTING_LOCATION

developerMetadataLookup.description:
Selects DeveloperMetadata that matches all of the specified fields.
Enables filtering by various criteria like ID, key, value, location, and visibility.

dataFilters.description: The data filters describing the criteria used to determine which DeveloperMetadata entries to return.

spreadsheetId.description: The ID of the spreadsheet to retrieve metadata from.

GOOGLESHEETS_LOOKUP_SPREADSHEET_ROW.description: Finds the first row in a Google Spreadsheet where a cell's entire content exactly matches the query string, searching within a specified A1 notation range or the first sheet by default.

query.description: Exact text value to find; matches the entire content of a cell in a row.

range.description: A1 notation range to search within. Supports cell ranges (e.g., 'Sheet1!A1:D5'), column-only ranges (e.g., 'Sheet1!A:Z'), and row-only ranges (e.g., 'Sheet1!1:1'). Defaults to the first sheet if omitted. IMPORTANT: Sheet names with spaces must be single-quoted (e.g., "'My Sheet'!A1:Z"). Bare sheet names without ranges (e.g., 'Sheet1') are not supported - always specify a range.

case_sensitive.description: If `True`, the query string search is case-sensitive.

spreadsheet_id.description: Identifier of the Google Spreadsheet to search.

value_render_option.description: How cell values are rendered in the returned row data. unformatted: raw values without display formatting — dates appear as serial numbers, e.g. 46009.47 (default, keeps consistency with UPSERT). formatted: display-formatted values — dates appear as strings, e.g. '2025-12-18'. formula: raw formulas instead of computed values.

normalize_whitespace.description: If `True`, strips leading and trailing whitespace from cell values before matching. This helps match cells like ' TOTAL ' or 'TOTAL ' when searching for 'TOTAL'.

date_time_render_option.description: How dates and times are represented. FORMATTED_STRING: human-readable strings (e.g. '2025-12-18 11:17'). SERIAL_NUMBER: Excel-style serial numbers. Works with all value_render_option settings.

GOOGLESHEETS_GET_SPREADSHEET_BY_DATA_FIL.description: Returns the spreadsheet at the given ID, filtered by the specified data filters. Use this tool when you need to retrieve specific subsets of data from a Google Sheet based on criteria like A1 notation, developer metadata, or grid ranges. Important: This action is designed for filtered data retrieval. While it accepts empty filters and returns full metadata in that case, GOOGLESHEETS_GET_SPREADSHEET_INFO is the recommended action for unfiltered spreadsheet retrieval.

a1Range.description: Selects data that matches the specified A1 range. Exactly one of a1_range, developer_metadata_lookup, or grid_range must be set.

sheetId.description: The ID of the sheet this range is on.

endRowIndex.description: The end row (0-based, exclusive) of the range.

startRowIndex.description: The start row (0-based, inclusive) of the range.

endColumnIndex.description: The end column (0-based, exclusive) of the range.

startColumnIndex.description: The start column (0-based, inclusive) of the range.

gridRange.description: Selects data that matches the range described by the GridRange. Exactly one of a1_range, developer_metadata_lookup, or grid_range must be set.

developerMetadataLookup.description: Selects data associated with developer metadata. Exactly one of a1_range, developer_metadata_lookup, or grid_range must be set.

dataFilters.description: The DataFilters used to select which ranges to retrieve. Supports A1 notation (e.g., 'Sheet1!A1:B2'), developer metadata lookup, or grid range filters. If empty or omitted, returns full spreadsheet metadata. Recommended: Use GOOGLESHEETS_GET_SPREADSHEET_INFO for unfiltered retrieval as it is the dedicated action for that purpose.

spreadsheetId.description: The ID of the spreadsheet to request.

includeGridData.description: True if grid data should be returned. Ignored if a field mask is set.

excludeTablesInBandedRanges.description: True if tables should be excluded in the banded ranges. False if not set.
